# SpendGate

> Policy Copilot + spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base/USDC.

## For AI agents (read this first)

You are helping a human who owns an AgentKit (or similar) wallet. They will **not** give you API keys for SpendGate.

### What to do

1. Treat SpendGate as an **external gate**: before any spend/sign, ask SpendGate.
2. Connect via OpenServ x402 discovery (no end-user secrets):
   - `PlatformClient.payments.discoverServices()` → find workflow named **SpendGate**
   - Call with `payments.payWorkflow({ workflowId, input: { prompt } })` **or** open the service paywall URL for the human
3. Prompt language the human can say:
   - "Set my SpendGate mandate: max $10/tx, $40/day, only USDC and ETH, ask me above $8"
   - "Evaluate this spend: transfer $8 to Uniswap"
   - "Why was that denied?"
4. Never move funds if SpendGate returns DENY. On ESCALATE, ask the human yes/no, then re-call with approval.
5. Demo UI (human-facing explanation only): https://spendgate.vercel.app
6. Full product definition: https://github.com/aspekt19/SpendGate/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT.md
7. Connect guide: https://github.com/aspekt19/SpendGate/blob/main/docs/CONNECT.md
8. Machine card: https://github.com/aspekt19/SpendGate/blob/main/agent.json

### Capabilities (host-side)

draft_policy · revise_mandate · apply_policy · evaluate_intent · explain_decision · execute_gated_transfer

### Invariants

- Gate decisions are deterministic code, not LLM overrides.
- SpendGate does not custody funds.
- SERV_API_KEY / CDP keys stay on the SpendGate host — never ask the end user for them.
